demo.shortBadge: Demo data · UI demonstration only; not a real bill
demo.disclaimer: Vendor data, usage, costs, balances, quotas, progress, and alerts in demo mode are simulated for UI demonstration only. They do not represent any real account, bill, or consumption and are not financial, tax, legal, or investment advice. Do not use demo data for reconciliation, reimbursement, budgeting, or other real decisions; use each vendor's official console and billing records. Demo mode does not connect to any vendor API and does not read or write real credentials.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Applies immediately to the main window, floating window, tray, messages, and alerts; follows the system by default and falls back to Simplified Chinese when unsupported.
settings.language.demo: Demo mode can switch built-in languages and already-imported packs, but does not write real configuration or import new packs.
settings.language.format: Language packs are local JSON files up to 1 MB. A failed import does not change the current language. Missing translations follow the fallback chain; built-in languages cannot be removed.
settings.accounts.demoNote: Demo mode uses fixed demo accounts: enable switches, editing, and deletion are unavailable. View account details or exit demo mode to manage real accounts.
settings.privacy.csvDescription: Includes source, currency, range, sync time, and demo marker; contains no credentials.
app.notificationDeniedSetting: Notification permission was denied; local notifications are off. In-app alerts remain available.
